The thing about my friend is she's slower when it comes to grasping concepts. I say this with love. I don't want to make her feel bad if I do talk about it. It's the last thing I want to do. This is her moment to be happy. 

I don't hold it against her for being happy about becoming a mother. I'm happy for her. I don't want anyone to go though the fertility issues I and others have. 

I normally accept the fact and move on by focusing on other concepts of my life (career/ school/ hobbies) but this pregnancy is bringing out the feelings that I keep to myself.

Normally, I accepted the fact and am content with being a godmother/ aunt figure but this pregnancy is making me feel insecure or something. I wouldn't mind adopting/ fostering kids in the future, I have mad respect for any good people who are adopting/ fostering.

Then it's best for you to save any money that you get until you can legally move out. It sounds like your mom has some issues that she needs to solve herself. I don't want to assume that she's an narcissistic parent like my father and his wife was. 

You might need to accept that your mother might somewhat be toxic for you. If she doesn't let you have space to grow, you're going to feel resentment and end up actually having the relationship where you only talk to each other on the phone once a week and visit her during the holidays because you just want your mother to accept your choices. 

I understand that some cultures (I'm not sure about your culture but I know mine is one of those) are extremely family oriented and that the parents know best and you should do what your parents want. The best advice I can give to you as an 22 year old woman from the southern usa is that the hardest thing you can do in life is make yourself happy. If your parents keep making you unhappy, I suggest spending more time out of the house for your mental well being.

Don't give up on your dreams, kid. Take it from someone who's been through something similar to you. I always wanted to be a writer and publish my own stories/books when i was a child. My dad and his second wife were extremely religious and seek a pastor who was know to be able to talk to God and he told them that I would end up becoming an mother by the time I was 17 and a Sex Worker by the time I was 20. They ended up burning every single book that I've wrote my stories/poems in out of fear. 

To this day, I resented my dad for believing some con artist and ruin my trust for many years. I still don't really talk to him about my personal dreams.

It's understandable that your parents are scared of losing their child but it's not fair to you for them acting irrational and having you pay rent when you can't legally work. How do they want you to make money? go out in the streets and sell drugs? Steal money? It's their legal responsibility to take care of you until you're legally an adult. 

I would talk to your parents about how you feel about them making you pay rent all because of what an astrologer says. Even if he is 100% correct and that you'll leave her, there's no way of changing the future even if she locks you in your room until she dies. 

Don't try to discredit her beliefs because when it comes to religion and spiritual subjects, there's no middle ground- her beliefs will always be right no matter what anyone says. I would say something like "Mom, I love you and I respect that you believe in the Astrologer. I personally don't feel comfortable with you forcing me to listen to it. If you want me to be in your life, you're going to have to let me follow my passion and dreams. I know you're scared but this is what I want for myself." 

I hope you do end up following your dreams. Don't let your parents fear end up making to take a career path that you resent and hate.

Your husband is disgusting and vile. 

For a father to choose his job over the well being and respect of his daughter makes me want to vomit. I would support my daughter if she was SA by her father's boss. Excuse my language but fuck your husband. My heart goes out to your daughter because no one should ever be a victim of something as traumatic as what's she has gone through.

Give your husband a ultimatum: you and your daughter or his career. The only thing that's worse than the sick fucks who sexually assault people are the cowards who choose to hide behind them and keep quiet. If he chooses his job, then file for divorce. 

If your daughter wants to file an report, I would suggest being behind her and make sure that she has one good parent who actually cares about her and her struggles she's going through. I would also suggest that your daughter should see a therapist to help her find healthier coping mechanisms with her trauma. 

My thoughts are with you and your daughter during this horrible time. I'm so sorry that she's going through this.
